summary.text: Ben Hymes is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 38 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and U.S. Navy veteran, he is running against Kayla Miller (D).

paragraphs.text: Ben Hymes lives in Waldo, Maine, and has served in the U.S. Navy.
His career experience includes owning a business.
He was assigned to the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee in 2023-2024 and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
